text:
AnitaP: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Opening this thread for follow-ups about headcount, small team merges, and manager timing. Drop quick Qs here.

DevonM: What do you mean by "small team merges"? Will folks be re-assigned or kept on same projects?

AnitaP: We're consolidating two runtime squads into one to reduce handoffs. People stay on the same product area where possible; a few engineers may shift to adjacent components. Managers will share impact lists by EOD. Not a layoff. :shield:

HiroT: Timing question: if I apply for an internal manager role in the merged team, when would comp/promo be effective?

PeopleOpsBot: Promotion policy reminder: compensation changes are effective on the approval date. Typical approval window is ~26 days after a promotion decision is submitted. Please work with People Ops early.

KimR: For planning interviews, can we get a simple tracker of which seats are approved vs tentative?

AnitaP: Yes. We'll publish a read-only headcount tracker (org -> seats approved -> tranche) by next Tue. It'll show which roles are prioritized in Q1 vs Q3.

SamB: If revenue dips and we pause hires, how will we prioritize the remaining open reqs?

AnitaP: Prioritization rubric: 1) customer-impacting infra (SLO/SRE), 2) revenue-facing roles, 3) critical product enablers. We'll publish the rubric and expected fallback plan.

DevonM: Any change to interview loop for mid-level infra? Heard there was a pilot.

HiroT: Yep pilot: two interviews (systems deep-dive + collaboration) for mid-level ICs; senior roles keep the full loop. Pilot expands next quarter. Details in #eng-hiring.

KimR: Will internal candidates be fast-tracked?

PeopleOpsBot: Internal candidates get scheduling priority and recruiter support. Mark "internal first" on the req in Greenhouse so we can route matches.

AllHandsBot: Recording + slides: https://redwood/all-hands/2498765432. Action items will be posted in the all-hands follow-up doc.

AnitaP: Thanks all. Managers: pre-clear communications with People Ops before posting team changes publicly. Closing thread in 48h unless more Qs.
